ddl_steps.name: drop-stale-fixture
ddl_steps.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t53fx; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t53fx_b

ddl_steps.name: create-fixtures
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t53fx (id INT PRIMARY KEY, a INT, b VARCHAR(20)); CREATE TABLE t53fx_b (id INT PRIMARY KEY, b VARCHAR(20))

verify.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='golden' AND table_name IN ('t53fx','t53fx_b')

ddl_steps.name: create-meta-fixture
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t53m (id INT PRIMARY KEY, a INT); INSERT INTO t53m VALUES (1,5)

ddl_steps.name: seed-rows
ddl_steps.sql: INSERT INTO t53fx VALUES (1,10,'x'),(2,20,'y'); INSERT INTO t53fx_b VALUES (1,'bx'),(2,'by')

verify.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM golden.t53fx)+(SELECT count(*) FROM golden.t53fx_b)
SELECT count(*) FROM golden.t53fx WHERE a>10
SELECT count(*) FROM golden.t53fx WHERE a>10

ddl_steps.name: cleanup
ddl_steps.sql: DROP TABLE t53fx; DROP TABLE t53fx_b; DROP TABLE t53m
